reviewer: independent source-frame reviewer; assistant visual inspection, not user approval
reference_role: attachment 2 N04 is a search hint only; no reference video pixels used for registration or image evidence
method: Independently initialize from red hair+bow edges with symmetric distance soft-L1, then refine isotropic scale+translation on RGB of red hair and adjacent dark hair ink in upper 70% of red bounding box. Hands, sleeves, apron, background and subtitles never used for RGB fitting. No rotation, mirror, nonuniform or nonrigid transform. Residual red-edge metrics can be high from bow/arm occlusions and are not classification proof. Visual inspection required.
classification_rule: A head/hair fit is supporting evidence only. Confirmed same visible geometry requires eye-inspection of exposed hands, arms, clothing outline and interior lines under that same isotropic transform. No nonrigid transformation. Not evidence of hidden pixels or author-cel identity.
limitations: 21 unique selected pairs reviewed: 12 independent original-frame/independent-head-fit examinations plus 9 primary-classification spotchecks. Not complete independent visual revalidation of all 49.
Head-only registration estimates have approximately pixel-scale sampling bias, not production alignment matrices.
Dark-ink threshold overlay loses internal strokes inside dark flat fills; source-color side-by-side inspection is authoritative.
No G12 image can establish off-canvas legs, feet, skirt hem, or a cropped-out hand.
No conclusion about author intent/approval, audio or cel identity. Alternative G33 mapping is reviewed separately by the primary worker and is not independently certified in this report.
No manifest/count/code/cels/source/alpha mutation; only new independent review evidence.
summary_zh: 抽样已证实G12/G33存在统一放大裁切的同源关系，但并非所有旧配对都能整张纯裁切：至少本轮CROSS28有衣纹差，CROSS32/37/42有手势或双臂姿态差；CROSS45另有颜色差。不能因头像重叠或数字相似就把49组全部扣减。
